selection: temperature and salinity at depth centers >= 2000 m
target: normalized full state; no delta/background transform
feedback: deep predictions from previous two-output call; A current true nondeep input; B zero normalized nondeep input
primary_evaluation: matched one-call two-output truth-history evaluation; never unrestricted A free forecast
loss: original dynamic update on 10 selected channels only; limit100; active two-slot mean summed over4calls
unsupervised_outputs: not usable predictions, excluded from feedback/loss/evaluation
